headline: Gigabyte BIOS update hints at Intel CPUs supporting DDR4 on old sockets
summary: A Gigabyte BIOS update adds support for upcoming Intel LGA 1700 processors on B760 and H610 motherboards, pointing to a rumored 'Raptor Lake Next' lineup expected in early 2027 that would support both DDR4 and DDR5 memory, letting new CPUs run on older sockets.

claims.statement: A Gigabyte BIOS update hints that Intel will launch new CPUs on old sockets that support DDR4 memory.

sources.quote: Gigabyte's latest BIOS update hints at Intel's Raptor Lake Next Launch in 2027
Intel is reportedly launching new CPUs on old sockets that support DDR4 memory
